1.o: blings (سوكا وكتارا) يكتشف مراهقان يعيشان في القطب الجنوبي صبيًا غريبًا جدًا (Aang) ، جنبًا إلى جنب مع حيوانه الأليف الذي يطير البيسون آبا ، في جبل جليدي.  لكن هل يمكنهم الوثوق به عندما يوجه الحرب بطريق الخطأ إلى عتبة قريتهم؟

2.o: يكتشفا  كاتارا و سوكا أن آنج هو الافاتار المفقود منذ زمن طويل ويجب أن ينقذه عندما يخطفه أمير شارد يُدعى زوكو

3.o: آنج ‎متحمس للعودة إلى المنزل (معبد الهواء الجنوبي) لأول مرة منذ مائة عام ، لكنه صُدم عندما اكتشف أن المعبد مهجور.  يخبر آنج  سوكا وكتارا عن طفولته أثناء استكشافهما للمعبد ، لكن سرعان ما يكتشفان شيئًا لم يتوقعه آنج  أبدًا.  في هذه الأثناء ، يجب على الأمير زوكو إجراء إصلاحات لسفينته والطريقة الوحيدة التي يمكنه بها القيام بذلك هي إرساء سفينته في القاعدة البحرية لمنافسه.

4.o: تصل العصابة إلى جزيرة كيوشي ويلتقطها بعض محاربي كيوشي.  عندما يكشف Aang أنه الصورة الرمزية ، تنتشر الأخبار بسرعة وتصل فجأة إلى الأمير Zuko الذي يذهب بعد ذلك إلى جزيرة Kyoshi للقبض عليه.

5.o: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a strange king.

6.o: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find. After Haru is captured for earthbending, Katara is compelled to rescue him.

7.o: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

8.o: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

9.o: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.  When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her abilities at a pirate’s store, she decides to steal it, realizing that she couldn’t hope to afford it.

10.o: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.  However, when a charismatic young man and his band of rebels attack the Fire Nation camp and rescue them, they learn that they are trying to resist the Fire Nation’s motives to expand their territory.  Katara and Aang really enjoy their time with the band of rebels, but Sokka soon discovers that they aren’t as noble as meets the eye.

11.o: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.  Aang decides to walk across with the two groups to ensure they don’t fight one another.  However, he soon learns that the two tribes have been feuding for one hundred years and they both believe their actions are justified.  But when the predators inside the canyon start to come out, Aang is stuck trying to defend both tribes from each other and the vicious wildlife.

12.o: Sokka accepts a job for a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. After the fisherman finds out Aang is the Avatar, Aang runs away in response to the fisherman's hostile reaction. When Katara finds Aang, he begins to reveal his life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, after Zuko gets into a fight with his crew, Iroh tells them about Zuko's complicated past, attempting to make both sides understand each other.

13.o: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends. But before he can get the medicine he is captured by the newly promoted Admiral Zhao and put in Zhao's fortress.

14.o: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years. But when Sokka and Aang discover one of the fortuneteller's most vital predictions is dead wrong, they have to develop a plan to convince the stubborn townspeople that their beloved Aunt Wu was wrong.

15.o: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father. Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down, his friendship is put to the test as he must deal with t

16.o: Team Avatar learns of a firebending master who deserted the Fire Lord’s army. This may be Aang’s only chance to learn firebending, but the deserter warns that the young Avatar is not yet ready for the control a firebender needs.

17.o: Arriving at the Northern Air Temple, Aang is upset to discover the sacred place being desecrated by a brilliant inventor intent on renovating it into a home for his displaced family.

18.o: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead. As they are taken there, Aang and Katara are eager to find a waterbending master, only to discover that girls are not allowed to learn waterbending.

19.o: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in hopes of saving one of the most prominent areas of the world.

20.o: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe. Iroh makes a powerful stand and Zuko struggles to keep his plan intact.

1.o: British Museum curator Lady Alex Lindo-Parker jets off to the Amazon in search of Victorian explorer Percy Fawcett's lost camp. A series of mishaps sees her joined by maverick American adventurer Hooten and they stumble upon El Dorado.

2.o: Hooten asks Lady Alex to help him search for the Sibylline Books - a collection of lost mystical prophecies from ancient Rome. The British Museum curator accepts, but quickly finds herself scaling the Sistine Chapel, battling a sewer alligator and clashing with the Mafia.

3.o: Alex heads to Egypt, where she teams up with Hooten to find the long-lost tomb of Alexander the Great - but some unscrupulous locals are hot on their heels.

4.o: Lady Alex and Hooten head to the remote Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan in search of an ancient scroll rumoured to have been written by the Buddha himself.

5.o: When Ella is kidnapped in Ethiopia, Lady Alex and Hooten head to Africa where they they must overcome crazed bandits and surly camels in order to save the day.

6.o: Lady Alex jets off to Moscow to help Hooten in his search for a lost Faberge egg and confronts her arch enemy from university, who now works for a shadowy black market collector, but they soon become entangled in a sinister criminal underworld.

7.o: Lady Alex and Hooten attempt to track down the priceless Cintamani jewel in Cambodia, but they quickly attract the attention of a ruthless drug gang.

8.o: Alex puts her wedding in jeopardy as she follows Hooten to an idyllic Caribbean island, searching for Captain Henry Morgan's buried pirate treasure. With half a map each and other hunters on their tail, this larger-than-life expedition threatens to derail the biggest day in Lady Alex's life.

1.o: In 1958, the nobleman Dam-Ryung releases a mermaid back into the ocean. In present-day Seoul, the figure of conman Joon-Jae stands on the same spot.

2.o: Joon-Jae brings a beautiful woman back to his hotel, unaware that she's a mermaid. Jin-Ok realizes she's been scammed and sends men after Joon-Jae.

3.o: With no memory, Joon-Jae finds himself alone on a beach next to a jade bracelet and a single pearl. Meanwhile, the mermaid crosses the ocean to Seoul.

4.o: At the aquarium, Joon-Jae runs into a woman being chased by security. Feeling a sense of déjà vu, Joon-Jae rescues her and brings her home.

5.o: Joon-Jae lives with the woman who he names Sim Chung. Fugitive Dae-Young has been on the run for 3 months when a murder occurs near Joon-Jae's house.

6.o: Sim Chung is involved in a traffic accident. Joon-Jae rushes to the hospital to find her in critical condition.

7.o: Joon-Jae tells Sim Chung he loves her. Meanwhile, detective Hong comes across Dae-Young while investigating a murder.

8.o: Jung-Hoon teaches Sim Chung that jealousy is the way to a man's heart. Meanwhile, Joon-Jae sees an image of a man with a mermaid on an ancient vase.

9.o: Joon-Jae finally faces off with his pursuer Dae-Young. He suffers a major injury and confesses his feelings to Sim Chung before losing consciousness.

10.o: In a museum, Joon-Jae sees a figure in a painting that looks just like him. Unable to identify the figure as Dam-Ryung, he grows distraught.

11.o: Sim Chung leaves the house after learning Joon-Jae is a conman. In a panic, Joon-Jae desperately searches for her.

12.o: Joon-Jae is arrested by detective Hong. When Sim Chung realizes they are in danger, she tracks them down.

13.o: Joon-Jae is still having strange dreams. Sim Chung hears Joon-Jae say the name Se-Hwa in his sleep. She asks him who he is talking about.

14.o: With Professor Jin's help, Joon-Jae learns he is an ancestor of Dam-Ryung. To avoid a tragic fate, he decides to protect Sim Chung whatever it takes.

15.o: Sim Chung's heart will stop without Joon-Jae's love. Upon learning this, Joon-Jae talks about his dreams and finding out that Sim Chung is a mermaid.

16.o: Joon-Jae and Yoo-Ran have an emotional reunion at Sim Chung's birthday party. Joon-Jae learns why Dae-Young has been chasing him.

17.o: After almost being caught by Dae-Young, Sim Chung erases his memory. In the process, she witnesses the final moments of Dam-Ryung and Se-Hwa.

18.o: After Il-Joong's death, detective Hong gets a warrant to search Seo-Hee for evidence. Meanwhile, Chi-Hyun threatens Nam-Doo to get him to cooperate.

19.o: Chi-Hyun points a gun at Joon-Jae, but Sim Chung jumps in front and is shot. She slips into a coma, causing Joon-Jae to fall into despair.

20.o: Sim Chung erases Joon-Jae's memory and returns to the ocean. When Joon-Jae wakes up, there's only a single pearl next to him. Three years pass...

1.o: Tsukimi and her friends are a bunch of nerds plagued by crippling social anxieties, but a late night jellyfish rescue mission and the arrival of a mysterious “Stylish Girl” are about turn their lives upside down!

2.o: No matter how much she begs to be left alone, Tsukimi just can’t shake her Stylish new friend. When the Sisterhood’s weekly Hot-Pot Party rolls around - an event the Stylish are NOT welcome at - problems arise, jellyfish speak, and meat saves the day!

3.o: Kuranosuke tries to bond with Tsukimi by introducing her to the wonderful world of makeup, but transforming this drab girl into a Stylish may be more than she can handle!

4.t: I'll See You in My Aquarium
4.o: Sweet potatoes and bittersweet memories send Tsukimi straight to the aquarium. The fabulous Kuranosuke decides to tag along, and so does his severely-smitten brother Shu!

5.t: I Want to Be a Jellyfish
5.o: The Sisterhood encounters their super-sexy enemy for the first time, Tsukimi is crushed by jealousy, and Mayaya dresses up like the one and only Nicole Richie!

6.o: Kuranosuke works his make-up magic to turn the Sisterhood Stylish and then drags them out for a bite to eat. Meanwhile, Inari uses her feminine charms to lure Shu to a bar, but her motives are sinister.

7.o: Extortion is the story of the hour as Inari puts the squeeze on Shu after their “night of passion,” and Kuranosuke tries to blackmail his own father over his extramarital activities!

8.o: Kuranosuke’s scheme to get rich selling old dishes hits a snag when the flea market customers decide they only have eyes for Tsukimi’s jellyfish dolls! Can the sisterhood keep up with the demand for more baby Claras?

9.o: An ill-fated attempt to design a jellyfish dress is derailed when Tsukimi and Kuranosuke witness Inari’s shocking announcement that she and Shu have slept together!

10.t: Days of Love and Lukewarm Water
10.o: Kuranosuke pulls out all the stops to convince Tsukimi not to give up her jelly fish dress dreams. Pep talks and bribes lead to a seamstress soiree at the Koibuchi mansion, but our heroines are in for a big surprise upon their return home!

11.o: The Sisterhood scrambles for a solution to keep their all-girl pad intact. Kuranosuke comes up with an outrageous plan to use Tsukimi’s jellyfish dress to take the fashion world by storm—and it might just be crazy enough to work!

The towels are already clean. MaXi then decide to use the laundry money to go to Lunatic with their friends.

14.o: Petunia presents her family with plans to expand her factory, but much to Mara's chagrin, these renovations will encroach on a wasteland. Waves are extremely rare plants with incredible properties.

MaXi decides to introduce people to her, but no one agrees, until they think of Jack. At first reluctant, Jack ends up getting along very well with Plato; a bit too much, even.

16.o: The members of Germinator present their brand new track to Olivier. It's the first time they've played in front of an audience and they're so stressed that things don't go as planned. Mara suggests they do some meditation, to re-synchronize with Vakarma's rhythm.

17.o: MaXi need money to record a demo with Germinator, but Pierre refuses to finance them. He finds that he and Petunia already give them a sufficient allowance; if they want more, they will have to find a job. He tells them about Tuba, who just needs help getting rid of her old barn, but MaXi refuses.

23.o: Molo wonders if the Great Trees can still hear him and if he can still impart his knowledge to them now that he is potted. MaXi decides to take her to see Plato, who may have some answers to her questions.

26.o: MaXi's parents tell them that today is a big day. When they were born, Vakarma spoke to Pierre and Petunia to tell them that MaXi were very special children to whom she had granted special powers.
